summary: [re-bless] With `language: en` configured on a Korean brief, '2026-09-14 회의에서 반납 직후 영수증을 보여 주기로 결정했다.' no longer draws prose.decision-history (the re-blessed case drops it): a date now needs an English decision verb. Consistent with the override, but a configured language that disagrees with the text now misses a dated decision it caught before.
